findings.verification: Choose v in Pperp with v^2=delta^2 and g0 delta=v. Then f_g0=0 and g0 in S. The explicitly orthogonal curve R(z) on span(v,W) satisfies Rv=c(z)v+zW and RW=-z W^2/delta^2 v+c(z)W with c^2=1-z^2 W^2/delta^2. Hence g(z)=R(z)g0 is outside S for every small nonzero z. S is not analytically, hence not Zariski, open.
